_comment: Donations received outside Stripe (no card fee). Methodology compute is deducted first: max(live ledger total, projected_methodology_spend_cents while the locked run is in progress), capped at the donation. The remainder is shown as allocated to the funding queue in order, like card donations, but DISPLAY-ONLY: it is never written to the milestones table, so allocateAndLaunch() never sees it and it cannot trigger a launch. A milestone it would complete is shown as 'funded, launch pending review'.
